Which booking site listed the lowest prices for Ocean City hotels?

The study's count, before taxes and fees: in the September 29, 2026 snapshot, at 9 of the 18 Ocean City hotels with a price, the lowest-priced listing was 5% or more below the going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Super.com at 2, the hotel's own site at 2, Vio.com at 2, klook at 1, Traveluro at 1 and trivago DEALS at 1. These are the Ocean City rows of the study's per-hotel CSV (going_rate_usd and cheapest_usd, before taxes and fees).

Taxes and fees at Ocean City hotels

At the 12 hotels with both an all-in and a before-tax going rate, taxes and fees, as the booking sites reported them to Google Hotels, added a median of 12% ($10 a night) to the before-tax going rate: from 10% at Princess Royale Oceanfront Resort to 13% at Comfort Inn Ocean City Boardwalk. At 6 hotels no site reported a before-tax price, so their prices are listed prices that may leave out resort or property fees. Our data does not split the gap into taxes and fees.
